claims.text: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 reached general availability on April 3, 2026, merging Semantic Kernel and AutoGen.
Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 provides checkpointed graph workflows.
AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime isolates each session in a dedicated microVM.
LangGraph recommends PostgresSaver as the checkpointer for production because in-memory checkpointers lose all checkpoints on restart.
CrewAI recommends that production applications start with a Flow that orchestrates Crews as steps.
CrewAI Flows use the @persist decorator to provide durable state.
